title: Golden Sansam
wikitext:
'''Golden Sansam''' is an [[herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (260). The plant is found mostly in [[Un'Goro Crater]], but also in [[Azshara]], the [[Hinterlands]], [[Burning Steppes]], [[Feralas]], [[Felwood]], [[Eastern Plaguelands]]. [[Lapidis Isle]], & [[Gillijim's Isle]].
